description: Postes electriques (Distribution) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération du Puy-en-Velay. This dataset represents the position of the public distribution stations (HTA/BT stations) of the distribution network operated by Enedis. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération du Puy-en-Velay. The portal shows the English title as "Electrical stations (Distribution)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération du Puy-en-Velay. Its keywords include electricite, reseaux-de-transport, inspire. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS, OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
